create_NotebookProgressBar: create a NotebookProgressBar to display a live progress bar in Jupyter notebooks with configurable total iterations and prefix
create_NotebookTrainingTracker: create a NotebookTrainingTracker to track training progress with embedded metrics table and child progress bars
create_NotebookProgressCallback: create a NotebookProgressCallback TrainerCallback to display training and evaluation progress bars in notebooks
build_html_progress_bar: build an HTML progress bar string from value, total, prefix, and label for embedding in notebook displays
build_text_to_html_table: build an HTML table string from a list of text items with header row and data rows for notebook rendering
